svg.title: 77.7% lower cost per solved task, in our pilot.
svg.desc: In a small internal pilot with one model, a solved task cost 77.7% less with relevant Vexen memory: about 1.1 cents instead of 4.8 cents, 4.5 times cheaper. A run cost about 11% less; the rest of the drop is because more runs succeeded (60% against 15%). One check adds at most 1,800 bytes. Twenty runs per group, synthetic tasks, not a general cost-saving claim.
